The goodwill recognized is attributable primarily to expected synergies, the acquired assembled workforce, and the economies of scale 
expected from combining the operations of 2010 acquisitions and the Company. Certain amounts of the acquired goodwill is expected to be 
deductible for income tax purposes; however we are unable to estimate the total amount at this time. 
  
The Company recognized $6.3 million of acquisition-related costs in 2010. These costs were expensed in the period incurred and reported in 
the Company's consolidated statement of operations as acquisition-related and other charges. There were no acquisitions or acquisition 
related charges incurred by the Company in 2009 and 2008.
